title: Grunge
tagline: Heavy guitars, rough edges, and songs from a local scene.
summary: Grunge grew from a Pacific Northwest network of independent bands, venues, and labels. Its songs often joined distorted guitars and forceful dynamics with punk directness and a range of melodic influences. The style reached a much larger audience in the early 1990s, but its roots remain tied to collaborative local music-making. Bands associated with grunge each developed a distinct sound.
origin_place: Seattle and the Pacific Northwest, United States

pillars.name: Mudhoney
pillars.why: Mudhoney helped define the raw, fuzz-heavy sound of Seattle's early grunge scene.

pillars.name: Nirvana
pillars.why: Nirvana brought the underground scene's dynamic songwriting to a wide audience without losing its punk roots.

pillars.name: Soundgarden
pillars.why: Soundgarden combined heavy riffing and adventurous structures, showing one expansive side of grunge.
